review.notes: No hard-rule breach shown and not undercut on present evidence (no embroidered 7 ft panel at or below Rs 900 found on Amazon.in, Flipkart or Meesho on 2026-11-28), and the margin passes at Rs 515/Rs 1,999 (55.62%). But the Rs 515 machine-embroidered listing has no size, seller or MOQ (the 4x8 ft listing at Rs 1,000 gives 29.03%, FAIL), and no weight source exists; a scaled comparable suggests a lined 7x4 ft panel could approach or exceed 2 kg. So we need a written quote (size, lining, MOQ, single-piece dispatch) and a weighed sample before any spend.

Indian hits were Woodenstreet (Rs 989, 7 ft, embroidery unconfirmed) and iTokri (applique, Rs 1,790-1,850). So no embroidered 7 ft panel at or below about Rs 900 on a mass marketplace was evidenced and the caller's undercut/'commodity' test is not triggered. Researcher's Flipkart HOMEMONDE 7 ft PRINTED cotton at Rs 688 is a pack-of-2 printed item (per URL), not embroidered.
